description: Defines the V4L2DevicePoller class for polling V4L2 devices, managing polling thread, callbacks, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: V4L2DevicePoller
classes.description: Manages polling of a V4L2 device on a dedicated thread, providing callbacks for events and errors, with thread synchronization.

methods.name: V4L2DevicePoller
methods.description: Constructor initializing the poller with a device and thread name.

methods.name: StartPolling
methods.description: Begins polling with specified event and error callbacks.

methods.name: StopPolling
methods.description: Stops polling and terminates the polling thread.

methods.name: SchedulePoll
methods.description: Requests a polling operation to be performed.
